perron.bound_type: floating-point Collatz diagnostics, not rigorous interval arithmetic

limitations: Formal fixed-d semiclassical expansion; no uniform spectral remainder proof.
Positive radial edge localization is supported numerically; off-axis roots excluded by an existing exact theorem.
Literature search covers direct neighbors, not a proof of exhaustive novelty.
Equation-by-equation source comparison uses arXiv v2, not the access-restricted publisher PDF.
Number relaxation rate requires nonzero normalized observable overlap; complex and Jordan roots can add oscillatory or polynomial factors.
Parity exclusion applies to one-time even-state/even-observable measurements, not all fermionic two-time correlators.
Long-time readout mixing is accompanied by very small post-selection survival; no practical precision advantage claimed.
